defect: A full canonical outbox returns Ok(true) on every unchanged turn. The runner resets idle backoff forever despite publishing nothing and reading no input.
fix: Count the initial queue depth and report work at the intake limit only if an event was applied, the session renewed, or publication/removal reduced the queue.
impact: Sequencer V2 hot path. A full blocked queue uses the existing bounded idle backoff, including its confirmation polling delay. No new idle duration or cap, synchronization, service wiring, wire format or deployment setting.

negative.result: fails on the parent at the assertion that a blocked turn reports no work

validation.replay: The oversized-replay control still reports work when it publishes a prefix and leaves the queue at its cap.

benchmark.profile: 256 senders x 17 nonces; 4096 held suffixes at the default outbox cap
benchmark.invariants: Every input is admitted; exactly one prefix per sender publishes before timing; every transaction publishes once canonical feedback resumes.

limitations: No specific CI outage attributed to this defect.
Local loop time excludes actual idle sleep and transport; it is not a client latency or TPS measurement.
Deployed performance and full CI remain required for the final combined change.
